name: William Solomon Ball
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 125432952 (Nancy Tate Ball, 1788–1840, Ball Cemetery, Hawkins County)
Bonnie Ball, "The Balls of Fairfax and Stafford in Virginia" (1961), entry 33, William Ball, and his children 110–119 (Internet Archive)
notes: Given by Find a Grave as a son of William and Nancy (Tate) Ball, a private who died in 1862 (UNPROVEN: no record seen). The 1875 suit names instead the unknown heirs of a William Ball Jr., deceased, whom Bonnie Ball says died in Roane County; whether these are one man or two is not settled.
